notes: GE built-in dishwashers of the 2016 stainless steel tub series: the guide covers the GDT695SxJ0xx with the GDT655, GDF650, GDF570 and DDT595 models. Features such as the power dry fan and the detergent cup release may differ between models of the series.

gaps: The wet heater row prints 793 W and 6.6 A at 120 V but 16.4 ohms; the figures do not agree with each other and are given as printed.
The resistance-versus-temperature table on page 9 names no component, so no thermistor claim is made.
No watts are printed for the circulation pump or the drain pump (amps and locked-rotor amps only).
Page 49 prints the fill valve resistance as 32 with no unit and cuts off the fill volume; page 9 gives 32 ohms and 0.83 GPM, which are used.
Page 9 notes that some models have a 13.5 VDC output to the detergent module, so the detergent cup release may not be on every model of the series.
ManualsLib's page text separates the table columns; rows were aligned by position and agree across three readings of page 9 and one of page 68. The PDF itself was not opened.
method: GE Appliances Technical Service Guide 31-9253 (April 2016, 76 pages), titled 'GE DDT595SxJ0 Series Technical Service Manual' on ManualsLib; its cover model list names DDT595SxJ0xx, GDF570SxJ0xx, GDF650SxJ0xx, GDT655SxJ0xx and GDT695SxJ0xx.
ManualsLib pages read as text with WebFetch: 9 (electrical values, AC and DC lists), 10 (subtitle), 49 (fill system, read for corroboration of the valve), 68 (dry system, heater table).
A direct request to ManualsLib outside WebFetch met a bot check and was dropped.
PartSelect and Sears PartsDirect pages were not opened (they refuse automated fetches).

comps.spec: Circulation pump: 120 VAC, 0.8 A, 3.8 LRA (locked rotor amps), 8 GPM at 5 PSI
Drain pump: 120 VAC, winding 27 ohms, 0.65 A
Dual-wattage four-pass Calrod heater, rated 120 VAC. Wet: 793 W, 16.4 ohms, 6.6 A. Dry: 625 W (+/-5 %), 23.2 ohms (+/-5 %), 5.2 A (+/-5 %)
Water (fill) valve: 13.5 VDC, 32 ohms, 0.83 GPM, about 1 minute cycle time
Turbidity sensor: 5 VDC to its LED, 10 kilohms
Rinse aid sensor: 5 VDC to its LED; feeds back 1 VDC when full and 4 VDC when low (below 20 ml)
Main control: input 120 VAC; outputs 120 VAC, and 5 and 13.5 VDC
Tub TCO (thermal cutoff): 120 VAC, rated 210 F (+/-10 F), manual reset
Power dry fan: 12 to 13.5 VDC, 6,000 rpm
Detergent cup release: 13.5 VDC, 25 ohms, one-second pulse to release the cup
Stainless steel tub (the guide's subtitle is 'Stainless steel tub dishwasher')
